attrs.evidence: True as stated at INV-R6.2 and too weak to be worth stating alone, which is why it is superseded rather than repaired. GPT-5.6 measured the implementation against its own prose twice. (1) The prose said the canonical set was `every mosaic/**.json`; the code enumerated `mosaic/*.json` + `mosaic/derived/*.json`, so `mosaic/newdir/new-registry.json` could be added to the finished artifact with the Mosaic gate still exiting 0 — the declared scope and the implemented scope were different sets and nothing compared them. (2) The larger hole: registries and gates are not the only bytes a transition promotes. `scripts/emb-battery-control.mjs` is the load-bearing evidence under two SETTLED claims and is neither a registry nor a gate, so it entered no manifest; a copy of the finished artifact with its final failure exit made unreachable passed check-mosaic, check-lineage and check-claim-ledger together.
